answer.why: The supplied excerpts provide no 28-day all-cause mortality counts or OR with two-sided 95% CI for BACC-Bay’s whole randomised intention-to-treat population. Numerical results discussed for other trials cannot substitute.
The text cites NCT04356937 but does not report 28-day all-cause mortality counts or effect estimates for the BACC-Bay trial.
